# GitBreakout

> GitBreakout discovers rising GitHub repositories using directly observed growth and activity signals.

## Public pages

- [Current rankings](https://gitbreakout.imbch.dev/): Breakout, Momentum, Current heat, and collected GitHub Trending ranks.
- [Archive](https://gitbreakout.imbch.dev/archive): Repositories no longer present in the latest candidate pool.
- [Track record](https://gitbreakout.imbch.dev/track-record): Verifiable observations recorded before GitHub Trending Daily.
- [Methodology](https://github.com/Changroro/git-breakout/blob/main/docs/methodology.md): Data sources, ranking formulas, evidence rules, and limitations.

## Data notes

- Rankings cover the observed candidate pool, not every repository on GitHub.
- Star history begins when GitBreakout first observes a repository.
- Missing evidence is not replaced with estimated historical values.
- Public activity archives are treated as lower-bound evidence when source coverage varies.
